blocks.html:
Motorcycle/Bike Wraps

Vinyl Wrap Toronto is seeing an increase in the number of people contacting us for bike wraps. Hitting the road on the bike season is here. This customer came to us after recently purchasing this BMW R1200. The bike was bought just a week before he asked us to wrap all the plastic body parts. The customer was not unhappy with the factory finish of the bike, he just wanted to customize the look.
Our installation crew gave the customer the option to save some money and time. If he could strip the parts off the bike and bring them to the garage. This is normally an option we give bike clients when it comes to colour changes. Our experience is that most people that own a bike and want to customize the look. Already know to modify the motorbike. He brought our crew the parts stripped from the bike and our team was able to turn the parts around within 2 days. The original colour was gloss black with gold accents.
After a little back and forth with the final colour and finish. The customer was excited to see the Avery Dennison SW900 Satin Black Vinyl wrapped parts. This BMW R1200 Bike wrap job was a pleasure. We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto cannot wait to see the parts back on the bike and hitting the road. We have included some before and after photos, the change is subtle in the photos, but on the bike a big change.

Follow this link to view another bike wrap, a Kawasaki Ninja 400 that needed some TLC and a few Naruto Decals.
